Requirements Your Reign of Beasts combo opening and Reign of Beasts. Make a melee gunblade Strike with 3d6 additional slashing damage. On a hit, up to two other enemies both within your reach and adjacent to the target each take 3d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. Secondary damage is not doubled by a critical hit on the primary Strike.

You may use only one Reign sequence action per turn. Consume the opening and enable Lion Heart until the end of your next turn. This does not grant Continuation.

Additional Strike damage @Damage[3d6[slashing]]; secondary @Damage[3d6[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]
